The statues on Iden Island and Tisk Island turned out to be fake.
What happened to the ancient god of Identisk Island?
Listen to Seeker #bBaz#k.
QuestInfo.1:

#e[Event Details]#n
The Seekers have concluded their investigation on the island.
The ancient god did exist on the island at one point in time.
But their power no longer remains.
That means the Sunlight Blessing and Wind Blessing are actually...

Talk to #bTomo#k about it.
QuestInfo.2:
#e#r<To the Island of Summer and Winter!>#k#n

#e[Event Period]#n
12/13/2023 12:00 AM - 02/06/2024 11:59 PM UTC

#e[Event Details]#n
Tomo doesn't look too surprised. His knowing nod seems to confirm that the Sunlight Blessing and Wind Blessing are likely primitive spells, and not from the ancient god.

npc.0: This will be hard for the people to accept. You don't need to tell anyone, but if you do... you should start by telling #bTomo#k, the leader of Tisk Island.
